chapter.li: LEChapter8 Verse1 And now it came to pass that Alma returned from the land of Gideon, after having taught the people of Gideon many things which cannot be written, having established the order of the church according as he had before done in the land of Zarahemla, yea, he returned to his own house at Zarahemla to rest himself from the labors which he had performed. VerseEnd Verse2 And thus ended the ninth year of the reign of the judges over the people of Nephi. VerseEnd

Verse3 And it came to pass in the commencement of the tenth year of the reign of the judges over the people of Nephi that Alma departed from thence and took his journey over into the land of Melek, on the west of the river Sidon, on the west by the borders of the wilderness. VerseEnd Verse4 And he began to teach the people in the land of Melek according to the Holy Order of God by which he had been called, and he began to teach the people throughout all the land of Melek. VerseEnd

Verse5 And it came to pass that the people came to him throughout all the borders of the land which was by the wilderness side. And they were baptized throughout all the land, VerseEnd Verse6 so that when he had finished his work at Melek, he departed thence and traveled three days’ journey on the north of the land of Melek; and he came to a city which was called Ammonihah. VerseEnd Verse7 Now it was the custom of the people of Nephi to call their lands, and their cities, and their villages — yea, even all their small villages — after the name of him who first possessed them; and thus it was with the land of Ammonihah. VerseEnd

Verse8 And it came to pass that when Alma had come to the city of Ammonihah, he began to preach the word of God unto them. VerseEnd Verse9 Now Satan had gotten great hold upon the hearts of the people of the city of Ammonihah; therefore, they would not hearken unto the words of Alma. VerseEnd Verse10 Nevertheless, Alma labored much in the spirit, wrestling with God in mighty prayer, that he would pour out his spirit upon the people who were in the city, that he would also grant that he might baptize them unto repentance. VerseEnd Verse11 Nevertheless, they hardened their hearts, saying unto him, Behold, we know that 2PSI thou art Alma; and we know that 2PSI thou art high priest over the church which 2PSI thou hast established in many parts of the land according to 2PP your tradition. And we are not of 2PSI thy church, and we do not believe in such foolish traditions. VerseEnd Verse12 And now we know that because we are not of 2PSI thy church, we know that 2PSI thou hast no power over us. And 2PSI thou hast delivered up the judgment seat unto Nephihah; therefore, 2PSI thou art not the chief judge over us. VerseEnd Verse13 Now when the people had said this, and had withstood all his words, and reviled him, and spit upon him, and caused that he should be cast out of their city, and he departed thence and took his journey towards the city which was called Aaron. VerseEnd

Verse14 And it came to pass that while he was journeying thither, being weighed down with sorrow, wading through much tribulation and anguish of soul because of the wickedness of the people who were in the city of Ammonihah, it came to pass that while Alma was thus weighed down with sorrow, behold, an angel of the Lord appeared unto him, saying, VerseEnd Verse15 Blessed art 2PSI thou, Alma. Therefore, lift up 2PSI thy head and rejoice, for 2PSI thou hast great cause to rejoice; for 2PSI thou hast been faithful in keeping the commandments of God from the time which 2PSI thou received 2PSI thy first message from him. Behold, I am he that delivered it unto 2PSF you. VerseEnd Verse16 And behold, I am sent to command 2PSI thee that 2PSI thou return to the city of Ammonihah and preach again unto the people of the city, yea, preach unto them, yea, say unto them, except they repent the Lord God will destroy them. VerseEnd Verse17 For behold, they do study at this time that they may destroy the liberty of 2PSI thy people — for thus saith the Lord — which is contrary to the statutes and judgments and commandments which he has given unto his people. VerseEnd

Verse18 Now it came to pass that after Alma had received his message from the angel of the Lord, he returned speedily to the land of Ammonihah. And he entered the city by another way, yea, by the way which was on the south of the city Ammonihah. VerseEnd Verse19 And it came to pass that as he entered the city, he was an hungered; and he said to a man, Will 2PSF ye give to an humble servant of God something to eat? VerseEnd Verse20 And the man said unto him, I am a Nephite, and I know that 2PSI thou art a holy prophet of God, for 2PSI thou art the man whom an angel said in a vision, 2PSI Thou shalt receive. Therefore, go with me into my house, and I will impart unto 2PSI thee of my food. And I know that 2PSI thou will be a blessing unto me and my house. VerseEnd Verse21 And it came to pass that the man received him into his house. And the man was called Amulek; and he brought forth bread and meat, and sat before Alma. VerseEnd

Verse22 And it came to pass that Alma ate bread and he was filled; and he blessed Amulek and his house, and he gave thanks unto God. VerseEnd Verse23 And after he had eat and was filled, he said unto Amulek, I am Alma, and am the high priest over the churches of God throughout the land. VerseEnd Verse24 And behold, I have been called to preach the word of God among all this people according to the spirit of revelation and prophecy. And I was in this land, and they would not receive me, but they cast me out. And I was about to set my back towards this land for ever. VerseEnd Verse25 But behold, I have been commanded that I should turn again and prophesy unto this people, yea, and to testify against them concerning their iniquities. VerseEnd Verse26 And now, Amulek, because 2PSI thou hast fed me and took me in, 2PSI thou art blessed; for I was an hungered, for I had fasted many days. VerseEnd Verse27 And Alma tarried many days with Amulek before he began to preach unto the people. VerseEnd

Verse28 And it came to pass that the people did wax more gross in their iniquities. VerseEnd Verse29 And the word came to Alma, saying, Go; and also say unto my servant Amulek, Go forth and prophesy unto this people, saying, Repent 2PP ye, for thus saith the Lord: Except 2PP ye repent, I will visit this people in mine anger; yea, and I will not turn my fierce anger away. VerseEnd Verse30 And Alma went forth, and also Amulek, among the people, to declare the words of God unto them. And they were filled with the holy ghost, VerseEnd Verse31 and they had power given unto them, insomuch that they could not be confined in dungeons, neither were it possible that any man could slay them. Nevertheless, they did not exercise their power until they were bound in bands and cast into prison. Now this was done that the Lord might show forth his power in them. VerseEnd
Verse32 And it came to pass that they went forth and began to preach and to prophesy unto the people according to the spirit and power which the Lord had given them. VerseEnd
